keySentence: The map held adventure — and the danger of greed.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim got ready for the trip. The ship was full of food and water. The wind was blowing. The map held adventure — and the danger of greed.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim helped load food and water onto the ship. Many sailors joined the crew for the voyage. Jim had never been on a long sea journey before. He felt nervous but determined to be brave. The map held adventure — and the danger of greed. The ship set sail toward the mysterious island.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: The preparations for the voyage were finally complete. The Hispaniola was loaded with supplies, and the crew was ready to sail. Jim felt a mixture of excitement and fear as he stepped onto the ship. He had never traveled far from home before, and the ocean seemed endless. The map held adventure — and the danger of greed. However, Jim noticed that some of the sailors looked rough and unfriendly. Because he was young, Jim decided to stay quiet and observe carefully. As the ship left the harbor, Jim wondered what awaited him on the treasure island.
facts.Word cards: greed = 탐욕 / adventure = 모험 / danger = 위험 / theme = 주제 / treasure = 보물
